summary: Joint-order group ID; all tasks in the group are assigned together or none.
businessRules: Atomic group: if any member is infeasible, the whole group is unassigned.

joint_order defines: Specify a joint order group ID that this shipment is associated with. Tasks having the same joint order group ID are treated as a single unit: either all tasks in the group are assigned, or none ar…
Numeric field; verify sign (positive/negative) and unit from spec.
Optional field. Omitting uses solver's default behavior (no penalty).
testingGuidance: Positive: two shipments sharing joint_order 3 both assigned.
Infeasible: one member of the group infeasible -> the whole group unassigned.
